query_instruction: Given a developer's message to a coding agent, retrieve the project memories (decisions, conventions, facts and past fixes) that are relevant to it
machine: Apple Silicon (arm64 darwin, 128 GB), Python 3.11, numpy 1.26.4, mlx 0.32.5, mlx-lm 0.32.2 (scratch install, removed after), fastembed bge-small-en-v1.5 for the lean arm
method: RET-1's recipe on the real warm models. Each corpus copied to a temp project; the lean index built with bge-small and the high twin built by the same build_index inside embed_mlx.using_space (what recall_warm_high does). Distributions via eval_floor's own _top_and_gap / _raw_max_cosines / recommend_floor (GRF-3) inside the high space. Hard-set and abstention via production recall() with index + index_dir (eval_metrics' path), inside the high space for the high arm; floor set through HIPPO_DENSE_FLOOR, gate thresholds patched in. OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1. write_floor_sweep/doctor's check_floor_calibration were not used to persist: the CLI sweep never enters a high space and doctor compares a sweep only against the lean model (it would call a high-space sweep stale).

corpora.golden: QUA-6 golden corpus, tests/golden_corpus/ (50 memories, 50 body chunks; hard_set.yaml 18 rows; abstention_set.yaml 6 probes). Public.
corpora.packs: the CI starter-pack corpus seeded per tests/fixtures/recall_hard_set.yaml's header (22 memories, 65 chunks; that fixture's 32 rows; tests/fixtures/recall_abstention_set.yaml 6 probes). Public.
corpora.hippo: this repo's own .claude/memory (108 memories, 272 chunks) with its project-local fixtures (38 rows: 16 single-hop + 22 multi-hop; 11 hand-authored off-topic probes). PRIVATE (gitignored): counts and cosines only, no queries or memory names.

gap.floor_rationale: low side of the clearly-off-topic gap (0.402, 0.495): 0.018 over the generic ceiling, 0.075 under the lowest on-topic best; the live hard set plateaus at its best 0.38-0.42 and loses rows from 0.43
gap.gate_rationale: both inside (0.454, 0.495): over every measured off-topic best including adjacent technical probes; strong under every on-topic best

not_calibrated.Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B: not run: weights not fetched (owner: calibrate the 4B only); falls to the 0.50 default with the gate off
not_calibrated.MRL-truncated spaces (model@dim): different cosine spaces; not covered by these entries
not_calibrated.count rule (recall_count._COUNT_BY_MODEL: no 4B entry: the count rule stays off on high, so a served call carries up to k rows

findings: Floor-independent loss on the live corpus: 3 hard-set rows lean finds are missed on high at every floor tried, including 0.0 (no floor), so they are the 4B's ranking, not the floor; 1 row lean misses is found. Net 31/38 vs lean 33/38; MRR 0.592 vs 0.569.
Golden and starter-pack corpora: high matches lean's recall (18/18, 32/32) with higher MRR (0.958 vs 0.909, 0.808 vs 0.707).

Abstention on the corpora's own off-topic fixtures is at parity with lean on all three (5/6, 6/6, 7/11). Adjacent technical probes on the live corpus: high 8/12 vs lean 11/12; the extra leaks are admitted by the gate's model-independent rank-agreement path (two shared terms with a memory in both lanes' top 10), not by a cosine.
